ad_check_user_exist.desc: 检查 AD 域中是否存在指定用户，并返回账号状态

params.username: string 用户的登录名 (SamAccountName)，例如 'zhangsan'

ad_check_user_exist.script: $user = Get-ADUser -Identity $username -Properties DisplayName, Enabled -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($user) { [PSCustomObject]@{ Exists = $true; Name = $user.Name; DisplayName = $user.DisplayName; Enabled = $user.Enabled; DN = $user.DistinguishedName } } else { [PSCustomObject]@{ Exists = $false; Message = '用户不存在' } }

ad_search_users.desc: 根据姓名或登录名模糊搜索 AD 用户，返回匹配的用户列表

params.keyword: string 搜索关键字（如：'张' 或 'zhang'）

ad_search_users.script: $pattern = '*' + ($keyword -replace '[*?\[\]]', '') + '*'; Get-ADUser -Filter { Name -like $pattern -or SamAccountName -like $pattern } -Properties DisplayName, Enabled, EmailAddress | Select-Object Name, SamAccountName, DisplayName, EmailAddress, Enabled

ad_check_group_exist.desc: 检查 AD 域中是否存在指定的组，并返回组信息

params.groupname: string 组名 (Name) 或 登录名 (SamAccountName)

ad_check_group_exist.script: $group = Get-ADGroup -Identity $groupname -Properties Description, GroupCategory, GroupScope -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($group) { [PSCustomObject]@{ Exists = $true; Name = $group.Name; Description = $group.Description; Category = $group.GroupCategory; Scope = $group.GroupScope } } else { [PSCustomObject]@{ Exists = $false; Message = '组不存在' } }

ad_check_user_in_group.desc: 检查指定用户是否在某个特定的 AD 组中
ad_check_user_in_group.script: $member = Get-ADGroupMember -Identity $groupname -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.SamAccountName -eq $username }; if ($member) { [PSCustomObject]@{ IsMember = $true; Username = $username; Group = $groupname; Message = '用户在组中' } } else { [PSCustomObject]@{ IsMember = $false; Username = $username; Group = $groupname; Message = '用户不在组中或用户/组不存在' } }

ad_get_user_groups.desc: 查询指定用户所属的所有 AD 组
ad_get_user_groups.script: $groups = Get-ADUser -Identity $username -Properties MemberOf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty MemberOf; if ($groups) { $groups | ForEach-Object { [PSCustomObject]@{ GroupDN = $_ } } } else { [PSCustomObject]@{ Message = '用户不存在或未加入任何组' } }
